components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 门店工作流中的决定性操作。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f3a5f; color: #fff; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 14px/20px 'Noto Sans SC', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0b2942; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgb(15 58 95 / 0.16); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a5c9f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: 用于搜索、筛选和录入业务信息。
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d9e2ec; border-radius: 10px; background: #f3f4f6; color: #111827; font: 400 14px/22px 'Noto Sans SC', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0f3a5f; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #d1e4ff; outline: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: 承载 KPI、筛选器和工作内容的结构化表面。
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #d9e2ec; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.05), 0 8px 22px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04); color: #111827; } .ds-card strong { color: #6b7280; font: 700 13px/18px 'Noto Sans SC', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card span { color: #0f3a5f; font: 850 26px/29px 'Noto Sans SC', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: 表达当前工作区和导航上下文。
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #e6f0f8; box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 #d1e4ff; color: #0f3a5f; font: 800 14px/20px 'Noto Sans SC', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: 用语义色表达订单、施工和财务状态。
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #dbeafe; color: #2563eb; font: 700 12px/16px 'Noto Sans SC', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: 清晰可靠的门店工作台
narrative.overview: MallBay 的界面应像门店每天依赖的运营工作台：可靠、清楚、能快速告诉使用者当前发生了什么，以及下一步该做什么。深蓝是稳定的品牌锚点，浅灰背景和白色表面构成安静的工作底板，业务状态通过有限且有语义的颜色表达。视觉方向采用结构化卡片与轻量阴影。卡片不是装饰，而是用于把 KPI、筛选、列表、待办和流程阶段分组；边界保持克制，阴影只提供轻微层次，避免让后台变成堆叠的浮层。
keyCharacteristics: 桌面与移动工作流连续

rules.name: The Deep-Blue Anchor Rule
rules.body: Deep blue establishes navigation, primary action, and operational authority; semantic colors should not compete with it.

rules.name: The Status-Has-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red, and blue are reserved for recognizable business states, not decoration.

rules.name: The Scan-First Type Rule
rules.body: Make the page title, next action, current status, and key value easy to locate before asking the user to read supporting copy.

rules.name: The Workbench Frame Rule
rules.body: Every management page should make its page title, primary action, current state, and main work area legible inside the shared shell.

rules.name: The One Canvas Rule
rules.body: Use surface changes and spacing to group work before adding another bordered card.

rules.name: The Quiet-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows should explain hierarchy, not advertise decoration; if a border and tonal shift are enough, do not add a stronger shadow.

dos: Do use the deep-blue family to establish navigation, primary action, and store context.
Do group related business content into structured surfaces with 16px internal rhythm.
Do make the next operational action and current status obvious through hierarchy and semantic feedback.
Do use subtle borders and tonal surfaces before stronger shadows.
donts: Don't turn every row, filter, or small control into a separate floating card.
Don't use tertiary red or other semantic colors as decorative accents.
Don't use heavy shadows, glassmorphism, gradients, or ornamental visual effects that reduce operational clarity.
